Message:
iwlwifi: mvm: add MVM_FW_MCAST_FILTER_PASS_ALL option

Add MVM_FW_MCAST_FILTER_PASS_ALL option to iwl-dbg-cfg.ini configuration file
to enable/disable FW multicast filtering.
